title.purpose: Names the utility in the setup header.

setup-label.purpose: Labels setup rows and the current pill state.

body.purpose: Carries setup details and recovery guidance.

transcript.purpose: Shows retained words only during recovery.

utility-hint.purpose: Shows secondary cancel and release instructions.

shadows.name: floating-pill
shadows.purpose: Separates the regular-material pill from apps behind it.

motion.name: pill-phase
motion.purpose: Animates recovery transitions unless Reduce Motion is enabled.

narrative.overview: Voco writes live words into the active text field. A minimal microphone capsule remains at the bottom center; continuous listening adds a stop control. Recovery alone displays retained text.
keyCharacteristics: Native system fonts, SF Symbols, semantic colors, and controls.
A 50pt microphone capsule for hold mode and an 80pt capsule for continuous mode.
Live corrections preserve surrounding text and stop after caret or document changes.

rules.name: Minimal microphone status
rules.body: Show retained transcript text only in recovery.

rules.name: Native appearance
rules.body: Follow system fonts, colors, controls, and Reduce Motion.

dos: Keep the microphone capsule centered at the bottom without taking focus.
Use live writing with corrections limited to the inserted range.
Keep Settings and manual transcript recovery accessible.
donts: Don't hard-code the dark appearance shown in the review captures; the implementation follows macOS appearance.
Don't replace system buttons, the picker, or SF Symbols with custom-drawn controls.
Don't turn the permission list into a set of decorative cards.
